Method of Attack: Installation of malicious Java plugins (JAR files) that execute commands received via HTTP GET and POST requests
Execution of arbitrary code and shell commands on compromised Openfire servers
Information gathering about compromised server (network connections, IP addresses, user data, kernel version)
Impacted Systems: Openfire messaging servers (versions 3.10.0 to 4.6.7 and 4.7.0 to 4.7.4)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2023-32315 authentication bypass vulnerability in Openfire administration console allowing creation of new admin accounts
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious plugin files: helloworld-openfire-plugin-assembly.jar, product.jar, bookmarks-openfire-plugin-assembly.jar, plugin.jar
